comparison.objective: Pull open a stiff window using its delicate handle; unlike sieve separation.
comparison.physical_skill: Force-limited handle grasp and linear pulling without auxiliary contact or handle damage.
comparison.success_condition: Credit follows counted handle-only opening distance; torn handle or damaged glass/frame forces zero. No material rubric detail is missing across all seven versions.
comparison.reason: Tests constrained linear actuation under a fragility limit.
